guard/31295.htm.text: Guard Henrik: Hey! What are you doing here? Just passing through, eh? Okay, you can pass. You should keep your head down! I've got a bad feeling about this place! I don't know why they had to name it the Gateway of Evil Spirits ! What were they thinking?!

links.text: "Who is the lord of the manor and what is the tax rate?"

guard/31295-1.htm.text: Guard Henrik: No kidding! I'll tell ya, this place really lives up to its name! Do you know about the uprising in Rune? They executed the rebels here!
